panels.title: Fix: show honest result when user never spoke
panels.scene: A villager weeping uncontrollably in front of a giant glowing magical stone. The stone displays the text 'RESULT: YOU SAID ZERO WORDS'. Knight stands beside it holding a wooden clipboard, looking completely deadpan.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The magic stone saw deep into my soul! It knew I stood in silence!

bubbles.speaker: Other Villager
bubbles.text: A miracle of truth! We shall build a temple for this feedback!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I added an if statement for empty strings.

panels.title: Fix: serve old card URIs so stale cache never shows blank card
panels.scene: Villagers screaming in panic around a floating invisible square, fearing 'the empty void'. The Knight casually tapes an old dusty paper map over the void.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The void was consuming our magical cards! Nothingness ruled the land!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: Your cache was stale. It now falls back to old image links.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: He banished the blankness with ancient scroll magic!

panels.title: Feat: 5 minute call so slower talkers reach phase 3
panels.scene: An extremely slow-moving giant turtle villager trying to speak. A giant five-minute hourglass floats above his head. The Knight leans against his sword waiting patiently.

bubbles.speaker: Turtle Villager
bubbles.text: Hello... I... am... ready... to... speak...

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: He granted the slow elders enough time to reach phase three!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I changed the timeout variable from two to five.

panels.title: 6 commits. 2 fixes. 4 features.
panels.scene: Knight sitting exhausted on a wooden stool, holding a cup of water. In the background, villagers are carving his face into the side of a giant mountain.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We are naming our newborn baby 'Phase-Three-Cache-Fix' in your honor!
